_comment: Default key/pointer -> UserIntent bindings for avatar + vessel control. Keys are bevy KeyCode variant names (e.g. 'KeyW', 'Space'); intents use the canonical USD control names. A vessel maps these intents to its ports via its USD Controls profile (see assets/vessels/control_profiles.usda). The look_button value selects the pointer button that activates the Look axis. This file is the single source of the default keymap.
